authority: User requested checking and starting the production selection plan; explicitly authorized Task A in the current checkout.
scope: Production-path development screening followed by independent release acceptance; runtime adoption and local frontend validation are conditional on passing the gates. Task A preparation only in this bundle.
corpus: Six current production runbooks; preserve provider eligibility, current/stale rules, citation hashes and top-three bound.
developmentProvenance: Exposed phase-11a-baseline-v6 sanitized synthetic development incidents, using graph.retrievalInput unchanged; not independent release evidence.
acceptanceProvenance: New independently authored and reviewed disjoint incident families, commissioned after method/configuration freeze; historical fresh R2.5 inputs are excluded.

gates.directPrecision: No reduction versus paired keyword; supporting usefulness reported separately.

accounting.alternatives: Each answer set is independently sufficient, with at most three indispensable sections; score best eligible alternative section recall, and report complete sufficient-answer coverage separately.
accounting.eligibility: If no sufficient answer set is fully eligible, exclude from eligible answerable recall; retain in all-incident coverage and report access exclusions. Missing corpus guidance is separately annotated.
accounting.noMatch: Only adjudicated genuine no-match cases; unavailable output is never successful abstention.
accounting.failure: Missing/failed positive outputs remain scheduled with zero recall, unavailable negatives remain in abstention denominator, and failures are separated from false abstention.
accounting.uncertainty: Report absolute case counts, macro section numerator/denominator, sufficient-answer fraction, paired scenario regressions and uncertainty; no small-sample reliability certification.

labelReview.rubric: Review every corpus section blind to method scores; distinguish direct answer, supporting guidance and irrelevant text. Record rationale, eligible sufficient alternatives, no-guidance/provider exclusions, missing runtime facts and disputed labels.
labelReview.freezeRequirement: Do not run the selection matrix until development labels and corpus are adjudicated and re-frozen. Existing direct questions may be a separate diagnostic cohort, never pooled with incidents.

budgets.livePreflight: Record verified pricing, serving payload/output token estimates and an explicit monetary ceiling within operational allowance before live calls; no paid fallback or billing changes.

runtimeChange: None until independently accepted method; rollback remains keyword plus restart.
